publication_state: candidate-only; no variant is cataloged until promotion

system.name: tetrakis(methylthiolate)-bridged [2Fe-2S] cluster
system.geometry: The numerical geometry is not encoded in the distributed FCIDUMP; inherited from the cited Li-Chan calculation

parent_hamiltonian.basis_and_orbital_provenance_limit: The FCIDUMP contains integrals and the CAS sector but no AO basis labels, coordinates, MO coefficients, or chemical orbital labels. These fields must not be reconstructed by guesswork.

citation.authors: Zhendong Li and Garnet Kin-Lic Chan
citation.title: Spin-projected matrix product states: Versatile tool for strongly correlated systems
citation.journal: Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation

shared_hamiltonian_conventions.legacy_archive_label_semantics: The sole label 0.0 is an archive point identifier, not a bond length, because the FCIDUMP has no coordinates

historical_cas4e4o.definition: Shared legacy default-RHF frame followed by the default CASCI(4,4) orbital partition and direct_spin1 FCI
historical_cas4e4o.claim_boundary: This reproduces the paper Hamiltonian but is neither a converged conventional RHF frame nor an ASF-selected active space.

historical_cas6e6o.definition: Checksum-bound reproduction of the supplied historical source: shared default PySCF RHF frame, default CASCI(6,6) orbital partition, then direct_spin1 FCI
historical_cas6e6o.claim_boundary: This reproduces the paper Hamiltonian but is neither a converged conventional RHF frame nor an ASF-selected active space.

historical_cas8e6o.definition: Shared legacy default-RHF frame followed by the default CASCI(8,6) orbital partition and direct_spin1 FCI
historical_cas8e6o.claim_boundary: This reproduces the paper Hamiltonian but is neither a converged conventional RHF frame nor an ASF-selected active space.

nested_cas8e8o.definition: Current-project same-protocol nested CAS(8e,8o) extension of the shared legacy default-RHF frame
nested_cas8e8o.claim_boundary: This is a validated nested comparison model, not one of the historical paper active spaces.
nested_cas8e8o.required_cross_version_validation: Independent PySCF 2.4/2.11 reports and an accepted cross-version certificate

asf_dmrg_cas6e6o.definition: Strict fixed-size Active Space Finder selection from pair information computed from singlet DMRG RDMs of the full Chan CAS(30e,20o) parent
asf_dmrg_cas6e6o.unfiltered_fallback_policy: Disabled by default; enabled only by the explicit --fallback-unfiltered flag, with strict failure and fallback use recorded in candidate_report.json

acceptance_policy.catalog_rule: Only promote a candidate whose report status is accepted, every Boolean gate passes, and every artifact checksum verifies
acceptance_policy.published_precision_note: All three historical paper targets are printed to six decimal places; the acceptance window is therefore capped at 1 microhartree. The recovered CAS(6e,6o) source produces -116.15625982795386 Ha, matching the printed -116.156259 Ha by truncation.
required_checks: parent FCIDUMP checksum and CAS header
requested CAS(4e,4o), CAS(6e,6o), CAS(8e,6o), derived nested CAS(8e,8o), or modern ASF CAS(6e,6o) sector
published CASCI energy reproduction for historical candidates, or accepted same-frame cross-version certification for the derived CAS(8e,8o) extension

shared_legacy_frame_validation.independent_cross_check: PySCF 2.11; all three CASCI energies and correlation descriptors agree within the recorded tight cross-version tolerances
